module.name: roksbnkctl-orphan-scan
module.description: List IBM Cloud resources named <prefix>-* that a failed teardown stranded — jumphosts, security groups, floating IPs, subnets, VPCs, the Transit Gateway, the registry COS instance, the ROKS cluster and the BNK trusted profile. Read-only: wraps `roksbnkctl cleanup --dry-run`.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix to sweep
required.description: roksbnkctl's cleanup sweeps for resources named <prefix>-* and deletes them in dependency order. This prefix IS the safety boundary: it is the only thing separating your leftovers from the rest of the account, which is shared — it holds ROKS clusters across nine regions belonging to other teams, plus VPCs named ecosystems-*, tf-*, pqt-*, garuda-* and tc-harness-*. Use the prefix this catalog's blueprints deploy under.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region to sweep. Inherits from the credential template. roksbnkctl also sweeps the client region recorded in the workspace.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the credential template.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Filled from the project's credential template at creation.
